# Skill: run-vitest-unit-tests

**When to use:** Run Angular service unit tests colocated under src/app (auth, article, profile services).

## Scope
- `src/app`
- `package.json`

## Prerequisites
- bun run setup completed

## Steps
1. Run bun run test for the default Vitest run.
2. Optionally run bun run test:ui or bun run test:coverage for interactive or coverage reports.

## Existing example
- `Test inventory lists src/app/core/auth/services/jwt.service.spec.ts, user.service.spec.ts, and feature service specs under src/app/features/.`
